constraints.name: support_tickets_order_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: support_tickets_requester_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (requester_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: vendors_latitude_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((latitude IS NULL) OR ((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (latitude <= (90)::double precision))))

constraints.name: vendors_longitude_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((longitude IS NULL) OR ((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (longitude <= (180)::double precision))))

constraints.name: vendors_owner_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
